      <p class="ws-sub">&ldquo;The decisions worth making this week are about your registry and your CODEOWNERS, not your agent vendor.&rdquo; (ch22 L192) Output: a governance policy the platform team can implement, ending with the audit question.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ws-meta">

Name one owner per decision and where it is checked; a position with no enforcement point is a preference.

  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>Printed beside the columns <span class="ws-block-note">what the book supplies &mdash; reference only, nothing to write here</span></h2>
    <table class="ws">
      <colgroup><col style="width:34%"><col style="width:33%"><col style="width:33%"></colgroup>
      <thead><tr><th>B3, B4, B6 &mdash; binding mode, trigger, cost cadence</th><th>B15 &mdash; semver class</th><th>B2, B11 &mdash; type and overlap</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody><tr>
        <td class="prior" style="font-size:7.4pt">Eager preload: every session &mdash; paid every session, unconditionally.<br>Eager (conditioned): thread touches a matching path &mdash; paid on every session matching the scope.<br>Lazy on-demand: description matches the task &mdash; description eager and small, body on activation.<br>Dispatcher-mediated: parent spawns and names it &mdash; paid only inside the child's context.<span class="prior-src">ch14 L79-85</span></td>
        <td class="prior" style="font-size:7.4pt">Body edit: Patch. New slot or asset: Minor. Reworded activation criteria: Major. Renamed or removed slot: Major. A changed transitive closure is recorded in the lockfile, not the package version.<span class="prior-src">ch21 L143-149</span></td>
        <td class="prior" style="font-size:7.4pt">Seven types: instruction file; agent configuration; skill; prompt; memory file; specification; hook (routed by the table at ch12 L451-459). COINCIDENTAL overlap is fine and needs no action; ESSENTIAL overlap is a missing dependency edge.<span class="prior-src">ch12 L451-459; ch21 L37-39</span></td>
      </tr></tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>Part B &mdash; register <span class="ws-block-note">one row per primitive &middot; B7 is ticked against the header-box line on sheet 1, not against any benchmark</span></h2>
    <table class="ws">
      <colgroup>
        <col style="width:3%"><col style="width:9%"><col style="width:9%"><col style="width:9%"><col style="width:7%"><col style="width:5%"><col style="width:5%"><col style="width:7%"><col style="width:5%"><col style="width:5%"><col style="width:7%"><col style="width:7%"><col style="width:6%"><col style="width:5%"><col style="width:5%"><col style="width:6%">
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr><th></th><th>B1 Path</th><th>B2 Primitive type</th><th>B3 Binding mode (confirm default or record exception)</th><th>B4 Trigger that loads it (actual glob, description or call)</th><th>B5 Measured size (tokens, measured)</th><th>B6 Cost cadence</th><th>B7 Eager and over our size line</th><th>B8 Owner and CODEOWNERS line</th><th>B9 Last edited</th><th>B10 Consuming teams</th><th>B11 Overlap</th><th>B12 If ESSENTIAL: extraction target and ticket</th><th>B13 In a manifest</th><th>B14 In a lockfile</th><th>B15 Last change and semver class</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
